description: Ablation arm of v3 (amendment A2): same data, search, seeds and partitions, with every urban-context channel held constant; only the collision history informs the network. Not publishable; answers whether exposure, environment and traffic proxies improve accuracy.

thresholds.method: Index = percentile rank (0-100) of the annualised indicator within the frozen reference distribution of all cell x subperiod estimates of the training years. Low < 40, medium 40 to < 70, high >= 70. Fixed before the test evaluation.
